groups.rationale: Only chapters 13 and 18 changed, for per-deployment fleet tunnels and telemetry roster options (ADR-0235); this group's behaviour, interfaces and verification are unchanged.

Lilly web ingress refuses guest port 5900 and only the Android display mark admits TCP 5900 to non-Customer ranges; DisplayHostBridgeTest separates host loss from live-host shutdown; the editor broker signals sd_notify readiness from Type=notify units; a test-only FreeBSD fault kernel, probe wrong-CID phase and native-freebsd-wrong-cid machine test passed (receipt a854e30e). Chapters 07, 08, 19, 20 and the native attestation scenario record scope and remaining OmniOS/DMA/reset/isolation gaps.
